title: FXVCS hydration state row, schema version 1 ($GIT_DIR/fxvcs/state.db)
description: Logical row of the per-worktree hydration table. Records per-path hydration intent, the pointer digest recorded in the Git index, the digest of the materialized working file, file identity/stat metadata used as a cache key, and last verification. Cache metadata is an optimization, never an integrity source: a changed size, mtime, or fileID invalidates workingDigest.

intent.description: Operator intent for this path in this worktree.

indexPointerDigest.description: SHA-256 of the exact pointer bytes in the Git index.

workingDigest.description: SHA-256 of the working-tree file bytes when last verified; null when unknown or the file is a pointer.

size.description: Working file size in bytes at last observation.

mtime.description: Working file modification time, Unix nanoseconds, at last observation.

fileID.description: Opaque platform file identity (device:inode on POSIX, volume:fileindex on Windows).

lastVerified.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the working bytes were last hashed and matched.

generation.description: Operation generation that last wrote this row (crash-recovery journal cross-reference).
